2026-10-27 (SCAN-1129 thread): first slice. 21 hand-rolled primary <button> class strings outside admin now use buttonClasses('primary', size) from the kit (connections, events, settings, spaces, claim and join pages, CRM capture). Remaining raw-button-bg sites are mostly selected-state toggle chips (bg-primary only when active), which need a kit segmented/chip control rather than a Button swap, plus admin files owned by the admin thread. Not re-frozen: the adoption counter needs Daniel to name it. 2026-10-26 bounded timer action pass: seated and movement session primary Pause/Resume/Begin now/Finish controls now render the shared Frequency Button (large) instead of duplicating primary palette, padding and pill geometry. Existing labels, click handlers, type and minimum width remain. This retires two raw primary-button sites only; the app-wide row remains open. Adoption and setup accessibility contract checks pass; full rendered timer and app-wide adoption acceptance are not claimed. 2026-10-26 timer navigation token pass: the empty-practice Browse practices link and completed-session contextual Dispatch link now share buttonClasses primary styling instead of hand-rolled palette, padding and radius utilities. Link hrefs, labels, overlay-close callbacks and anchor semantics are unchanged. This is two bounded action sites, not app-wide completion; SCAN-1133 remains open. Timer directory follow-up: remaining literal xl/2xl radii in on-air controls and feedback panels now use control/card tokens; Stop & Log in both engines and compact More settings use the existing ghost Button, and the Dispatch archive empty-state action uses buttonClasses. Custom pressed preset tiles, mode tabs, mode-accent actions, overlay scrims/close controls and branded mastheads retain their distinct semantics. Aggregate row remains open; no visual or whole-app completion claim.

2026-10-26 bounded admin-control batch: Connection settings Save changes, page Layout editor Save, and Email Studio Loom photo Use/Remove actions now use shared buttonClasses primary/dangerOutline variants and small sizing. Four hand-rolled geometry/palette class strings are retired across three files. Explicit button/submit types, pending/loading/selection disabled guards, labels, callbacks and form structure are preserved. This is partial adoption; full button sweep and rendered visual acceptance remain open.

Includes AI autonomy controls, review/recommendation actions, crew task creation, event settings, onboarding/elements/reward saves, CRM today actions, and Library Create/Sequence/Loom actions.
